label: NATS request/reply example
info: Nuclio consumes a native NATS request and returns the handler result on the NATS reply subject.

name: example-nats-request
configCode:
apiVersion: "nuclio.io/v1"
kind: NuclioFunction
spec:
  triggers:
    nats:
      kind: nats
      url: nats://nats:4222
      attributes:
        topic: example.nats.input
        queueName: demo-nats-request
        reply: true

name: Native NATS request/reply
info: Nuclio consumes example.nats.input directly and returns the handler result on the NATS reply subject. Run the nats-box command from the examples README.
